begin.label: Begin
begin.description: Entry point for the exec thread.

begin_batch.label: Begin Batch
begin_batch.description:
Entry point for batch execution.

The execution engine reads one CSV row at a time and runs the connected
exec thread for each row.

loop_control.label: Loop
loop_control.description:
Control-flow Loop node for visual programming.
- mode: Loop mode (N times, Until confirm)
- iterations: Number of times to loop (if mode is N times)
This node does not process data, but controls execution flow via logic sockets.

refine_stardist_model.label: Refine StarDist Model
refine_stardist_model.description: Fine-tune an existing StarDist model on new labelled data.

run_cellpose.label: Cellpose Segmentation
run_cellpose.description: Instance segmentation using Cellpose. Accepts pretrained or custom models. Runs on CPU or GPU (PyTorch).

run_stardist.label: StarDist Segmentation
run_stardist.description: Instance segmentation using StarDist. Small images run in an isolated subprocess; large images (above the streaming threshold) run out-of-core via predict_instances_big — reading the input block-by-block through the lazy dask graph (no copy) and writing labels to a zarr-backed lazy layer.

run_ultrack_node.label: Ultrack Tracking
run_ultrack_node.description: Cell tracking via Ultrack. Input must be a label mask time-series (T,Y,X) or (T,Z,Y,X).

train_cellpose.label: Train Cellpose Model
train_cellpose.description: Fine-tune a Cellpose model on labelled images. Saves model to ~/napari_flow_models/. Path is printed to console on completion.

train_stardist.label: Train StarDist Model
train_stardist.description: Train a StarDist 2D model from scratch. Saves model to napari_flow_editor/custom_models/.

adjust_gamma.label: Adjust Gamma
adjust_gamma.description: Gamma intensity correction. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

adjust_log.label: Adjust Log
adjust_log.description: Logarithmic intensity correction. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

adjust_sigmoid.label: Adjust Sigmoid
adjust_sigmoid.description: Sigmoid contrast adjustment. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

convert_to_grayscale.label: Convert to Grayscale
convert_to_grayscale.description: Collapse RGB/RGBA images to a single luminance channel using ITU-R BT.709 weights. Supports Dask arrays (lazy). Images whose last dim is not 3 or 4 pass through unchanged.

rescale_intensity.label: Rescale Intensity
rescale_intensity.description: Rescale image intensities from one explicit range to another. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

blob_dog.label: Blob DoG
blob_dog.description: Difference-of-Gaussians blob detector. Returns blob centres as a Points layer. Supports Dask (chunked).

blob_log.label: Blob LoG
blob_log.description: Laplacian-of-Gaussian blob detector. Returns blob centres as a Points layer. Supports Dask (chunked).

canny.label: Canny Edge Detector
canny.description: Canny edge detection. Returns a binary edge mask. CPU only — hysteresis requires the full image.

corner_harris.label: Corner Harris
corner_harris.description: Harris corner detector response map. Supports Dask+CUDA.

corner_shi_tomasi.label: Corner Shi-Tomasi
corner_shi_tomasi.description: Shi-Tomasi minimum-eigenvalue corner response map. Supports Dask+CUDA.

hog.label: HOG Visualization
hog.description: Histogram of Oriented Gradients visualisation. CPU only — cell/block grid spans the full image.

local_binary_pattern.label: Local Binary Pattern
local_binary_pattern.description: LBP texture descriptor. Supports Dask (2-D images). No CUDA equivalent in CuPy.

peak_local_max.label: Peak Local Max
peak_local_max.description: Finds local intensity maxima above a threshold. Returns peak coordinates as a Points layer. Supports Dask (chunked).

shape_index.label: Shape Index
shape_index.description: Koenderink shape index — encodes local surface curvature in [-1, 1]. Supports Dask+CUDA.

butterworth.label: Butterworth
butterworth.description: Frequency-domain Butterworth filter. Runs on CPU only (FFT requires the full image).

difference_of_gaussians.label: Difference of Gaussians
difference_of_gaussians.description: Band-pass filter via subtraction of two Gaussian smoothings. Supports Dask.

farid.label: Farid
farid.description: Farid & Simoncelli gradient magnitude. Supports Dask.

farid_horizontal.label: Farid Horizontal
farid_horizontal.description: Farid & Simoncelli horizontal derivative. Supports Dask.

farid_vertical.label: Farid Vertical
farid_vertical.description: Farid & Simoncelli vertical derivative. Supports Dask.

frangi.label: Frangi
frangi.description: Frangi vesselness filter (multi-scale). Full-image CPU because default gamma depends on a global Hessian norm.

gaussian_blur.label: Gaussian Blur
gaussian_blur.description: Applies Gaussian smoothing. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

hessian.label: Hessian (Ridge)
hessian.description: Hessian-based ridge filter (multi-scale). Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

laplace.label: Laplace
laplace.description: Laplacian edge detection via discrete convolution. Supports Dask.

median_filter.label: Median Filter
median_filter.description: Median filter with disk footprint. Supports Dask.

meijering.label: Meijering (Ridge)
meijering.description: Meijering neuriteness filter (multi-scale). Full-image CPU because the algorithm normalizes by global response maxima.

prewitt_filter.label: Prewitt Edge Det.
prewitt_filter.description: Prewitt gradient magnitude edge detector. Supports Dask.

roberts.label: Roberts
roberts.description: Roberts cross gradient edge detector. Supports Dask.

sato.label: Sato (Ridge)
sato.description: Sato tubeness filter (multi-scale). Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

scharr.label: Scharr
scharr.description: Scharr gradient magnitude edge detector. Supports Dask.

sobel_filter.label: Sobel Edge Det.
sobel_filter.description: Sobel gradient magnitude edge detector. Supports Dask.

threshold_isodata.label: Threshold Isodata
threshold_isodata.description: Global Isodata threshold mask. Computes the scalar threshold on the full spatial image, then applies a lazy mask when possible.

threshold_li.label: Threshold Li
threshold_li.description: Global Li threshold mask. Computes the scalar threshold on the full spatial image, then applies a lazy mask when possible.

threshold_local.label: Threshold Local
threshold_local.description: Adaptive local threshold mask. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

threshold_mean.label: Threshold Mean
threshold_mean.description: Global mean threshold mask. Computes one scalar threshold per spatial image, then applies a lazy mask when possible.

threshold_minimum.label: Threshold Minimum
threshold_minimum.description: Global minimum histogram threshold mask. Computes the scalar threshold on the full spatial image, then applies a lazy mask when possible.

threshold_niblack.label: Threshold Niblack
threshold_niblack.description: Niblack local threshold mask. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

threshold_otsu.label: Threshold Otsu
threshold_otsu.description: Global Otsu threshold mask. Computes the scalar threshold on the full spatial image, then applies a lazy mask when possible.

threshold_sauvola.label: Threshold Sauvola
threshold_sauvola.description: Sauvola local threshold mask. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

threshold_triangle.label: Threshold Triangle
threshold_triangle.description: Global triangle histogram threshold mask. Computes the scalar threshold on the full spatial image, then applies a lazy mask when possible.

threshold_yen.label: Threshold Yen
threshold_yen.description: Global Yen threshold mask. Computes the scalar threshold on the full spatial image, then applies a lazy mask when possible.

unsharp_mask.label: Unsharp Mask (Sharpen)
unsharp_mask.description: Sharpens image via unsharp masking (image - blurred). Supports Dask.

axis_map.label: Dimensions (e.g. T, Z, Z, Y, X)

load_csv.label: Load CSV
load_csv.description: Loads a CSV file and passes it to the next node.

open_image_file.label: Open Image File
open_image_file.description:
Open a regular image file (e.g. TIFF) using napari's reader plugins.
Returns a list of LayerDataTuples, same contract as Open Ome-Zarr.

select_layer.label: Select Layer
select_layer.description:
Select a layer by *name* from a list of napari LayerDataTuples:
  layers: [(data, meta, layer_type), ...]

Returns (data, meta) so downstream nodes receive just the data (engine will unpack),
while metadata stays available.

interactive.prompt: Select one incoming layer, then click Run.

blend_images.label: Blend Images
blend_images.description:
Because image_a and image_b have no defaults, 
the Generator automatically creates 2 Input Sockets for them.

interactive.prompt: Draw a rectangle on the image, then click Run.

project_3d_to_2d.label: Project 3D to 2D
project_3d_to_2d.description: Flattens a 3D volume into a 2D image layer.

join_tables.label: Join Tables
join_tables.description: Spatially join two tables. 'exact' columns must match (they block the search); 'approximate' columns are matched together by nearest-neighbor within each block, rejecting matches beyond Max Distance.

measure_labels.label: Region Properties
measure_labels.description:
Region properties table. One row per (frame, label) with a string cell_uid.

Slice-by-Slice iterates the leading axis (time / Z planes); 3D Volumetric
measures the whole volume as one. Property set adapts to the measured array's
dimensionality so 3D measurements never request 2D-only metrics.

track_statistics.label: Track Statistics
track_statistics.description: Computes per-track statistics from a tracks layer (track_id, t, y, x). Outputs an enriched table with length, duration, displacement, speed, and division info. Attach a Save Table node to write it to disk.

binary_closing.label: Binary Closing (Fill Holes)
binary_closing.description: Binary closing with an axis-aware footprint. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

binary_opening.label: Binary Opening (Remove Noise)
binary_opening.description: Binary opening with an axis-aware footprint. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

black_tophat.label: Black Tophat (Dark Spots)
black_tophat.description: Black tophat background subtraction. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

dilation.label: Dilation
dilation.description: Morphological dilation. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

erosion.label: Erosion (Shrink)
erosion.description: Morphological erosion. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

label_objects.label: Label Objects
label_objects.description: Label connected components. T and C are independent; full spatial core per label operation.

remove_small_holes.label: Remove Small Holes
remove_small_holes.description: Fill holes smaller than area_threshold. T and C are independent; full spatial core per connectivity check.

remove_small_objects.label: Remove Small Objects
remove_small_objects.description: Remove connected components smaller than min_size. T and C are independent; full spatial core per connectivity check.

skeletonize.label: Skeletonize
skeletonize.description: Skeletonize binary masks. T and C are processed independently; full spatial core is used.

white_tophat.label: White Tophat (Bright Spots)
white_tophat.description: White tophat background subtraction. Auto-selects Dask+CUDA, Dask, then CPU.

chan_vese.label: Chan Vese (Active Contour)
chan_vese.description:
Active contours without edges. Can segment objects without clear boundaries.
Returns a binary mask.

clear_border.label: Clear Border
clear_border.description: Clear objects connected to the border of the image.

expand_labels.label: Expand Labels
expand_labels.description: Expand labels in label image by distance pixels without overlapping.

find_boundaries.label: Find Boundaries
find_boundaries.description: Return bool mask where boundaries between labeled regions are True.

mark_boundaries.label: Mark Boundaries (Overlay)
mark_boundaries.description:
Returns the image with boundaries of the label_img superimposed.
NOTE: Requires 2 Inputs (Original Image + Label Mask).

quickshift.label: Quickshift
quickshift.description: Segments image using quickshift mode seeking.

random_walker.label: Random Walker
random_walker.description:
Random walker algorithm.
Determines segmentation of pixels based on probability of reaching markers.

Inputs:
1. image: Grayscale image.
2. markers: Seed map.

slic.label: SLIC (Superpixels)
slic.description: Segments image using k-means clustering in Color-(x,y,z) space.

watershed.label: Watershed
watershed.description:
Find watershed basins in `image` flooded from `markers`.

Inputs:
1. image: The "basin" image (usually gradient or inverted distance).
2. markers: An image with seeds (integers > 0) indicating where to start.

downscale_local_mean.label: Downscale (Binning)
downscale_local_mean.description:
Downsamples the image by local averaging (integer binning).
Good for reducing noise while shrinking.

rescale_image.label: Rescale (Zoom)
rescale_image.description:
Resizes the image by a scale factor.
Note: Safely handles RGB images by checking dimensions.

warp_polar.label: Warp Polar (Ring to Line)
warp_polar.description:
Remaps image to polar coordinates (Theta x Radius).
Useful for analyzing circular objects (like clocks, irises, or radial patterns).

make_video.label: Make Video
make_video.description:
Renders a viewer animation to MP4/GIF.
Use instruction rows to chain rotate/sweep segments.
For sweep, use axis idx options (idx:N).

interactive.prompt: Click Run to render the video from the current viewer state.

colocalization_scatter.label: Colocalization Scatter
colocalization_scatter.description:
Plots intensity of Channel 1 vs Channel 2 to show correlation.
Requires two images of the same size.

plot_histogram.label: Plot Histogram
plot_histogram.description: Generates a histogram plot from the image.

table_heatmap_plot.label: Table Heatmap
table_heatmap_plot.description:
Generates a heatmap figure from a Table/DataFrame.
Automatically selects only numeric columns.
